name: STAR Numerics — small linear systems
summary: Determinant, solution and inverse of a square matrix of order 1 to 20 by elimination in exact rational arithmetic, each result rounded once: conditioning costs no digit and singularity is decided exactly; equal to SymPy's exact results on all 151 systems of the cross-check, Hilbert matrices of order 6 to 12 included.
reference: Hilbert matrix of order 3 (MathWorld, Hilbert Matrix): determinant 1/2160, inverse ((9, -36, 30), (-36, 192, -180), (30, -180, 180)); scaled by 60 it has integer entries, determinant 100 and that inverse divided by 60

na.G-14: no performance requirement declared by any user

review.G-04: a is a list or tuple of rows; b a list or tuple; results are tuples
review.G-06: no external data; cross-check corpus generated with a fixed seed
review.G-08: pure functions, standard library only, no IO, no state
review.G-13: ValueError for every invalid input and for a singular matrix; a determinant of 0.0 can be an underflow, stated in the README
